description: Spec 012 T006 (FR-003; SRD Annex C §C.3): the declared tuning grid for the phase-4 reference trackers, chosen on the seed-211 validation split at σ = 1° and frozen in the decision record before any tracker is trained. Objective: median range error over every G5 row (zig + 5, 10, 15 and 20 min where reached; non-converged rows count as infinite). Widened from phase 3 after G0 (round 1, numerics): more turn-model acceleration noise (σ_ct to 0.3, so a speed change can be followed), more turn-rate noise (σ_ω to 0.03, for S-turns) and CV noise to 0.03. IMM in two stages: stage 1 scores every combination on the first stage1_scenarios qualifying scenarios; stage 2 re-scores the stage2_top best on all. The EKF grid is scored on all.
